scope: Only beam_layer brush/pen state optimization; production hardware/engine/ui unchanged; original NumPy
source: New isolated Windows root; copies of completed live_walk_07 and live_run_02, original recorded optical arrival cadence and original MJPEG index. Replay includes 3500 preflight samples before frozen checked point and all originally accepted post-arm frames. Independent clip oracle must match full A/B reports and original movement summary; preflight observer history may differ from long original preparation and is explicitly not substituted. No original evidence overwritten.
GUI: enabled native Qt windows; recorded JPEG preview selected at >=1/30s spacing (~25fps for 100fps archive), real SDK full-body service active on recorded inference poses; lower-limb joint/line paint active. No actual USB or DirectShow capture during controlled replay. Physical gimbal moves. Same conditions A/B.
smoke: One baseline P functional trial per mode before calibration; excluded prospectively from performance conclusions; smoke saves a single actual preview screenshot, calibration/A/B do not.

calibration.L: common end-of-batch observation when last sample crosses a 64-device-sample bucket; same raw/footprint/SDK evidence observer
calibration.P: L plus one lightweight completion record per inbox batch, no entry timestamps, call trees, per-frame clocks, Qt dispatcher/tick hooks, thread_time or cycles
calibration.comparison: Use common 64-sample-bucket observations for both L/P, same footprint measurement. P full records only for accepted A/B after calibration.
calibration.stop: If either mode fails any limit, preserve every round and do not start A/B or claim success.

AB.probe: P only after both modes pass A/A
AB.decision: Per-mode paired medians and full individual ranges; improvement must exceed 90th percentile absolute A/A paired noise in the same metric AND minimum material improvement. At least one primary metric must have all six paired gains positive (one-sided exact sign p=1/64), with no material regression in other acceptance metrics. This conservative criterion is frozen before runs. No missing-data success.

phases: Frozen original one-second device-window dense/mixed/empty labels from previous field summaries, no raw changes; source arrival lag and delivered camera/SDK/pose evidence retained. Empty-before/after separate.
recovery: From original last usable-contact scheduled host arrival to first consumed sample afterward with completion age <=10ms for a following 500-device-ms window (>=450ms covered), including reader lateness. Use common observations in A/A and P observations in A/B; no recovery is censored, never zero.
semantics: Every round raw bits/wire/validity/counters/order exactly selected source, all accepted raw archived; full report/quality/audit/runtime/window equal independent oracle after verifying and normalizing only two checked receipt clocks. Physical walking last-foot/count issue unchanged and out of optimization scope.
cleanup: May terminate child only after SystemExit(0), serialized measurement, closed raw/report, and confirmed SDK shutdown; outside all active measurement. Retain failure logs.
